title: Apple App Store Feedback Analyzer Input

mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: Collect review records or compare feedback around an Apple release.

appIds.title: Apple App Store app IDs
appIds.description: Numeric Apple App Store application IDs.

appStoreUrls.title: Apple App Store URLs
appStoreUrls.description: Public App Store URLs containing an /id<number> segment. Explicit app IDs are preserved and take precedence over duplicate URL IDs.

country.title: Apple storefront country
country.description: Two-letter storefront code used by the public RSS feed.

language.title: Requested feed locale
language.description: Locale hint sent to the public feed. Apple does not expose a guaranteed reviewer-language field in this feed; unknown language must remain unknown in downstream comparisons.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Hard cap after pagination and review-ID deduplication.

maxPagesPerApp.title: Maximum feed pages per app
maxPagesPerApp.description: Apple public feed pagination is bounded; the Actor caps this value at 10 pages.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout seconds
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for each public Apple feed request.

analysis.title: Shared analysis
analysis.description: Run the shared deterministic feedback-analysis core.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Attach shared analysis to collected reviews.

maxAttempts.title: Provider attempts
maxAttempts.description: Retry budget reserved for a future external provider.

aggregation.title: Clustering and reports
aggregation.description: Create platform-level clusters and per-app reports.

minimumClusterSize.title: Minimum cluster size
minimumClusterSize.description: Minimum actionable reviews required for a cluster.

release.title: Release metadata
release.description: Release metadata required by releaseImpact mode.

version.title: Version
version.description: Optional released app version for report context.

releasedAt.title: Released at
releasedAt.description: ISO date-time used as the release boundary.

daysBefore.title: Days before release
daysBefore.description: Calendar days collected before the release boundary.

daysAfter.title: Days after release
daysAfter.description: Calendar days collected after the release boundary.

maxReviewsPerPeriod.title: Maximum reviews per release period
maxReviewsPerPeriod.description: Hard cap applied to each release comparison collection.
